2842-4279-6112--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2842-4279-6112--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1903-4311-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3769-5571-8095--6.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3769-5571-8095--6.description:
Use Blim to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

728-7084-7885.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-4268.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2034-2415-4268.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

62-280-833-3827.notablePrerequisites:
Soul of Windgrace can attack without taking damage.
Savage Ventmaw can attack without taking damage.
62-280-833-3827.description:
Declare Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding six mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Golgari Rot Farm from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Golgari Rot Farm, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2021-2060-4029-6774.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4284-4890.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4284-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dack's Duplicate and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4284-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7782.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

240-2438-5434-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

3923-4050-6556-7639.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
3923-4050-6556-7639.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation by paying {U} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-5319-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2438-5319-6972.notes: If Geralf's Messenger starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

618-4456-7057-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Nightscape Familiar.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

6867-6869-7444.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1458-4404-6967.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-6967.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Honest Rutstein.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

413-5359-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-5359-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a number of creature tokens equal to its power.
When the creature tokens enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

443-5147-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
443-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Magus of the Bridge and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

803-5331-7082.description:
Cast Gemcutter Buccaneer by paying {3}{R}. When it enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
When the Treasure enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token which enters as a Pirate due to Arcane Adaptation.
When the Ally enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
Repeat from step 2.
803-5331-7082.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop in step 2. This must be stopped at some point or the game ends in a draw.

1734-2438-5987.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2557-2793-3743-5089-7178.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2557-2793-3743-5089-7178.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-5223-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

719-5310-6797-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
719-5310-6797-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

101-1692-2489-3732.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
101-1692-2489-3732.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
101-1692-2489-3732.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker with haste.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

5968-6797-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4871-6291-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

620-1495-6712.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has indestructible and either flash or haste.
620-1495-6712.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to the creature with indestructible.
Sonic's second ability triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat.

224-1772-3470-3861.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra trigger
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

1737-2104-2707-6504.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
1737-2104-2707-6504.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Temporal Manipulation onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

1445-2279-2921-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-2921-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

509-1267-1781-5548.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-1781-5548.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Thran Forge by paying {2}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Sword of Truth and Justice's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris and Sword of Truth and Justice trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Truth and Justice trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, then putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 7.

1109-1636-2263-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Skeleton Ship does not have summoning sickness.
Geralf's Mindcrusher does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1109-1636-2263-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher, adding one mana of any color.
Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Geralf's Mindcrusher enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, causing target player to mill five cards.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Geralf's Mindcrusher.
Repeat.

396-1333-2493-4050.notablePrerequisites: At least two of your opponents have a creature card in their graveyard.
396-1333-2493-4050.description:
Cast Ghouls' Night Out by paying {3}{B}{B}, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield, and at least two other creatures from your opponents' graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Archaeomancer and the creatures enter the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers once for each creature, and Archaeomancer triggers once.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghouls' Night Out from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating that many 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing Archaeomancer, two creatures your opponents own, and two Unicorns, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

438-4968.notablePrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
438-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to Deathbringer Thoctar's deathtouch.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this combo whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

228-1339-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature whose toughness is equal to one.
228-1339-4871.description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to a creature whose toughness is equal to one.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Skullclamp and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

57-2178-4813-5147.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-2178-4813-5147.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Famished Foragers that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Famished Foragers.
When Famished Foragers dies, Feldon triggers, untapping Feldon.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

507-1411.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Possibility Storm triggers, exiling the spell and then exiling cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card that shares a card type with it, and allow them to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Because Soulless Jailer prevents noncreature spells from being cast from exile, no player may cast noncreature spells as permitted by Possibility Storm.

628-1430-4053.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying {2}{U}, having it enter as a copy of Mikaeus.
Choose to have Mirror Image put into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mirror Image dies, triggering its undying ability, returning itself to the battlefield with no +1/+1 counters due to Solemnity, as a copy of Mikaeus.
Repeat from step 2.

813-1070-1777.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
Cast Rise Again by paying {4}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Rise Again from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2232-3142-3273-5012.description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, Flame's Catalyst onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Novice Pyromancer to your hand.
+1 Chandra, Flame's Catalyst dealing 3 damage to each opponent.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Novice Pyromancer onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Flame's Catalyst to your hand.
-1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

864-2730-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {B}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Eternal Witness.
Repeat.
